name: Pastor
overview: Scripture reveals that pastors are divinely appointed shepherds entrusted with feeding the flock of God with knowledge and understanding, as God promises to provide leaders according to His heart (Jeremiah 3:15; Acts 20:28). They are recognized as spiritual overseers and teachers within the church body (Ephesians 4:11), responsible for the care of souls and accountable to God for their ministry (Hebrews 13:17). The gravity of this role is underscored by the warning that many who teach will face greater judgment (James 3:1), and the consequences of unfaithful leadership are severe (Jeremiah 22:22).
